Secret. My telegram of 29th March. Cipher telegrams are passing between Mandalay and Italian and Swiss Agents probably refer to purchase of warlike material. Name of correspondent at Genoa is Durazzo AdornoCan anything be traced by this clue regarding actual consignments and shipping.
